name: Hiroshi Yoshimura, Wet Land (1993)
evidence: 5,089,008 views, 2,226 comments, 9.2 years old (should be asleep upload). 190 of the newest 300 top-level comments fall in the last 365 days, 11 in the last 30. That is 0.79 of its lifetime comment pace, against 0.11 to 0.13 for older uploads of Soundscape 1 and Green. Most-viewed of the 12 kankyo uploads tested, and not in the seed list. One 2026-02 commenter asks for albums with 'a calm, wet feeling like this masterpiece'.

name: Hiroshi Yoshimura, Green (1986)
evidence: Same record, two uploads, opposite reads: Cosmic Pickle 2,048,944 views, 84 comments in the last 365 days (0.90 of lifetime pace); Professor Swag 3,123,852 views, 15 in the last 365 days (0.13). Demand for a record can move between uploads, so one upload's fade does not prove the record faded.

name: Takashi Kokubo, Oasis of the Wind: Forest
evidence: 1,538,405 views, 644 comments, 24 in the last 365 days (0.29 of lifetime pace). Birdsong and forest record that commenters compare to Zelda in 2020-06, 2021-03 and 2022-05. Large but fading on this upload.

name: Zelda
evidence: Named unprompted by kankyo listeners: 18 distinct commenters across 17 separate months, 2019-05 to 2026-09, on 6 of 11 uploads (regex count over 2,909 top-level comments, not hand-read). Separate test: 'Relaxing Zelda Music with Campfire Ambience', 12,364,810 views, 253 comments in the last 365 days, 0.67 of lifetime pace.

name: Minecraft
evidence: Most-named world on kankyo uploads: 26 distinct commenters across 24 separate months, 2019-02 to 2026-09, on 9 of 11 uploads (regex count, not hand-read). No Minecraft ambient video tested yet, so this shows association and not demand for a calm Minecraft format.

name: Hollow Knight
evidence: Surfaced incidentally in a Zelda search: 'Relaxing Music with Ambiance', 5,903,315 views, 241 comments in the last 365 days, 0.70 of lifetime pace. Possible confound, not checked today: a sequel release could be lifting recent comments.

name: Super Mario Galaxy
evidence: Dead branch on the upload tested: 'Relaxing Super Mario Galaxy Soundtrack', 3,219,125 views, 4,533 comments, 9 in the last 365 days (0.02 of lifetime pace), despite kankyo listeners naming Mario (13 commenters, 13 months; regex includes the word 'galaxy', so noisy).

name: Mushishi
evidence: One commenter only on kankyo uploads (2026-02, Wet Land). Mushishi Full OST: 1,280,199 views, 613 comments, 8 in the last 365 days (0.13 of lifetime pace), though still_alive reads 0.96 because its window spans 1,892 days.

name: Haruomi Hosono, Watering a Flower (1984)
evidence: Crack's 2018-02-28 Japanese ambient list says it was commissioned as background music for Muji's Tokyo flagship and places Yoshimura's Nine Post Cards with the Hara Museum. Brooklyn Rail says Soundscape 1 came packaged with a prefab house and A.I.R. was tied to a Shiseido perfume. The canon's own 'worlds' are real places and functions. Demand not tested.

name: Kankyo YouTube upload comments
evidence: The one listener gathering place read directly today. Listeners name worlds there over many years, and other records too: Steve Roach Structures from Silence and Kerry Leimer Imposed Order (2026-07), Hand of Umi Time Sand (2021-05, on two uploads, likely one commenter), Moomin music (2025-09), the film August in the Water (2025-10). Each of these appeared once or from one person, so none recurs yet. r/ambientmusic could not be reached: search returned no threads and Reddit refused the fetch.

name: Brooklyn Rail, Playlist for Prefab Houses (2018)
evidence: History of the revival: nearly 2 million plays on an early Through the Looking Glass upload before its 2017 removal, listeners filling in track lists on YouTube, mixes by Jamie Tiller and Spencer Doran. Useful context, dated, and no measure of lasting demand.

name: Quest & Rest
evidence: Original-music fantasy rest channel with no franchise in its titles. Created 2025-03-06; 103,000 subs, 19,151,597 views, 177 videos. Top uploads: 'Rest... Let the storm pass' 4,939,204 views (2025-03-16), 'Finally, the rain... a long-awaited rest' 3,444,718 (2025-09-02). Its description says 'All music and visuals are exclusively created for this channel' (its own claim, unverified). Hand-read 30 top comments by relevance: people give their age, country and the hour, then say they are tired or wish others well. Comments ran 4.9 a day over the last 267 days against 8.3 lifetime, on a 428-day-old upload, too young to call lasting. Median of its newest 50 uploads is 9,930 views, so the views sit in a few hits.

name: Drift Away Ambience
evidence: Minecraft calm leader, built on C418's music per its description. Created 2024-01-14; 299,000 subs, 121,602,304 views, 587 videos. 'no more thinking tonight...' 20,451,954 views since 2025-06-03. Titles lead with a line to the listener, then '(minecraft music w/ soft rain)'. Newest 50 uploads span only since 2026-08-11, median 74,059 views. Comments 13.9 a day over the last 111 days against 20.4 lifetime on a 519-day-old upload, partly inflated by 'like this so I get reminded' chains among top comments. Too young to call lasting.

name: Minecraft (calm format)
evidence: Demand is large but older uploads fade while new ones take over: year_pace 0.05 (FULL SOUNDTRACK, 55.1M views), 0.09 (Music Box 10h, 22.4M), 0.13 (InfiniteDrift longplay, 13.7M), 0.23 (Ambient Crafts, 19.2M). Hand-read Drift Away's top 30 comments: childhood, siblings, loss and sleep, attached to the game and its music. Drift Away credits C418, so this demand may not transfer to original music (inference, untested). Ambient Crafts: 55,100 subs, newest 50 uploads median 467 views, against 19.2M on its 2023 hit.

name: Skyrim
evidence: Everness uploads: 'Music & Ambience' 21,253,874 views 0.45; 'Night [10 Hours]' 16,380,705 views 0.45; 'Night' 25,754,820 views 0.28; 'Rainy Night [10 Hours]' 14,116,471 views 0.16. Monthly counts on the Night 10h upload run steady at 13 to 33 threads over the last year and read as real people, many with memories of the game. The 149-minute upload holds some generic farm-style lines in 2026-08. Music is the OST (Everness credits Jeremy Soule). Some commenters mention Elder Scrolls 6, a possible confound, not tested.

name: Final Fantasy X
evidence: Small and mixed on the uploads tested: Relaxing FFX OST 933,179 views 0.38 (359 comments); 8-hour mix 525,798 views 0.91 (only 165 comments); lofi mix 848,041 views 0.11; TPR tribute 724,040 views 0.08. Besaid hour-long uploads top out at 523,839 views. Far smaller than Skyrim or Minecraft.

name: Hollow Knight (correction)
evidence: Corrects tick 1. Tenpers' 0.70 (0.73 today) is mostly inflated by generic comments, not by Silksong. About 158 of about 252 comments in the last year fall in 2026-08 and 2026-09, nearly all with zero likes and lines like 'The effort really shows' and 'I came, I watched, I subscribed'. Only 4 of 157 threads in those months mention the game (regex over each comment's first 80 characters, so a rough floor). Removing those two months gives about 0.27. Silksong launched 2025-09-04 (thepopverse.com/gaming-hollow-knight-silksong-release-date-2025); 2025-08 to 10 show only 23, 31 and 12 comments, a small lift mostly outside the window. Other uploads: Ezonater 0.39, n o o k 0.35, emphase 0.13.

name: Zelda (partial correction)
evidence: Corrects tick 1's 0.67 for 'Relaxing Zelda Music with Campfire Ambience': comment months spike at 50 in 2026-05 and 55 in 2026-09, and the 2026-09 sample holds farm-style lines ('I wish I found your channel sooner', twice), plus 223 of 254 threads at zero likes. Real comments remain, so the true pace is below 0.67 by an amount not measured today.

name: Hiroshi Yoshimura, Wet Land and Green (audit held)
evidence: Same farm-comment check as Hollow Knight. Wet Land: 190 threads in the last 365 days, spread 7 to 28 a month, spike-month sample reads as real listeners. Green (Cosmic Pickle): 84 threads, 2 to 13 a month, also reads as real. Tick 1's 0.79 and 0.90 stand on this check.

name: Comment farming distorts year_pace
evidence: Generic zero-like comments from throwaway-looking accounts appear on the Hollow Knight and Zelda uploads tested and to a lesser degree on one Skyrim upload. year_pace counts them as listeners. A high score now needs a read of its months and comment text before it is believed.

name: Chill Cartoon Vibes
evidence: Older sibling of Quest & Rest, so the rest format is more than one channel. Created 2024-03-25; 364,000 subs, 48,037,148 views, 421 uploads, median 19,911 views. Top: 'Rest, you're safe here...' 6,634,265 views (2025-02-03), 0.24; 'Stop here, traveler.. You deserve some rest' 3,362,304, 0.11; 'Alone With Your Thoughts And A Campfire For 6 Hours' 2,204,108, 0.05. Monthly threads on the top upload run 14 to 89 with no farm-looking spike in the sample, and they read as tired people talking to each other, with some religious spam. Its channel text ('Traveler, you are in a safe place') closely matches Quest & Rest's ('Traveler, this is your safe space') with the same section layout, so the two may not be independent; who runs them is unknown. Original music is not claimed in the text read.

name: spiritual brother
evidence: Rest format at one hour with declared original music ('All music is completely original and by me', its own claim). Created 2023-08-23; 91,600 subs, 16,561,309 views. 'i must rest here a moment' 6,382,305 views, 10,098 comments, 0.16 (uploaded 2024-09-19; 753 comments in the last 365 days, 15 to 82 threads a month). Next upload is 876,251, and the median is 9,515, so one hit carries the channel. A 2026-02 comment beginning '1 week sober' drew 480 likes. Tags name Silent Hill, Dark Souls and Elden Ring. The closest match to our one-hour length of any channel read today.

name: Silent Hill-inspired ambient (klr)
evidence: A franchise named on music credited to the channel: 'Copyright: Music by klr', 'inspired by sound of Silent Hill'. klr created 2024-02-28; 13,600 subs, 7,762,983 views. 'i lost myself in endless nothing | silent hill inspired ambient music' 1,119,721 views, 351 comments, 58 in the last 365 days, year_pace 0.40, spread 2 to 7 threads a month, no farm spike in the sample. One commenter in 2026-04: 'it's been a year now and not one week have I gone without listening to this'. Highest score of the format today, on thin counts and one upload. Other uploads under this label reach 485,664 and 348,309, unscored. Game release confounds not checked.

name: Ancient Egypt (Athena IV)
evidence: A place-world with no franchise, on a channel describing itself as 'Original Ambient Music and Soundscapes' (its own claim). Athena IV created 2021-04-30; 324,000 subs, 74,485,069 views. 'Valley of Time - Ancient Egyptian Ambient Music' 3,540,360 views (2024-09-30), 'Winds of Time' 3,142,092 (2024-05-02), against a channel median of 90,063. Not scored today, so views only and nothing yet on lasting.

name: Aero ambient (Athena IV)
evidence: A named aesthetic with recent traction: 'The Aero Skyway' 732,446 views (2026-03-19), 'The Aero Arcology' 707,647 (2026-03-06), 'The Flower Fields' 481,555 (2025-12-12), against a median of 42,105 on its newest 100 uploads. Also 'Reflection // Calming TRON-Inspired Ambient Music' 506,773 (2025-12-08). All under a year old, so they can't show lasting yet. Not scored.

name: Rest-format titles before 2023-11 (mostly Skyrim playlists)
evidence: Three older uploads faded hard. 'it's been a long journey, stop here and have some rest' (nobody, 2022-11-10) 2,554,240 views, 0.08. 'it's snowing and you're tired of running from life' (aTolphas, 2023-06-07) 974,874 views, 0.04. '6 Hour Rest Here Traveler' (Hueniverse, 2022-05-15) 3,255,742 views, 0.03. Commenters identify the first two as Skyrim music ('05:25 all's well (jeremy soule)', 'It's just a Skytim playlist'); the Hueniverse music was not established, and its commenters reference Dark Souls and Zelda. Only three uploads, picked by one search sorted by views, so this is not a survey. Suggests (inference) the title style predates the original-music channels and came from game playlists.

name: Quest & Rest (update)
evidence: 'Finally, the rain... a long-awaited rest' now 3,451,453 views. Comment pages hit the 12-page cap before a full year: 2,021 comments including replies from 2026-01 onward, so 0.67 is a floor score on a 428-day-old upload and is not comparable with the others. Monthly threads fell from 269 (2026-02) to 51 (2026-10). Spike month sample reads real: country, age, hour, tiredness.

name: New rest-title entrants, 2026
evidence: The title style is still attracting new channels. bluehour (created 2026-08-11): 7,000 subs, 3,063,741 views, 'let it go, you need sleep (ambient mix)' 718,328 views since 2026-08-31. alone again (created 2026-10-04): 426 subs, 'your mind can rest now' 21,539 views since 2026-10-29. Both say the music is their own or their friends'. bluehour's views run far ahead of its subs, and whether they were bought was not checked.
